info.title: Ledger API
info.description:
A double-entry banking ledger.

**Money is integers.** Every amount is a whole number of minor units (paise, cents).
Decimals and numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

**Reads are ownership-scoped.** Requesting a resource you do not own returns 404, not 403,
so identifiers cannot be probed for existence.

**Mutations are replayable.** Send `X-Idempotency-Key` and a retry is safe.

servers.description: Same origin (the console proxies to the API)

availableBalance.description: Balance minus outstanding holds. Debits are checked against this.

BalanceReport.description: The stored balance next to the balance computed from the journal.

balance.description: Amount in minor units (paise/cents). Integers only — never a decimal or a string.

availableBalance.description: Amount in minor units (paise/cents). Integers only — never a decimal or a string.

ledgerBalance.description: Credits minus debits, summed from the journal

totalCredits.description: Amount in minor units (paise/cents). Integers only — never a decimal or a string.

reconciled.description: False means the cached balance has drifted from the journal — the loudest alarm here.

amount.description: Amount in minor units (paise/cents). Integers only — never a decimal or a string.

status.description: PENDING is an uncaptured hold. Nothing has moved and no journal entries exist yet.

LedgerEntry.description: One side of a double-entry pair. Append-only: updates and deletes are refused.

balanceAfter.description: Account balance immediately after this entry

password.description: At least 10 characters with upper and lower case, a digit and a symbol.

verification.description: Present only while mail is mocked.
